en.headline: Customs seizes 6kg of suspected cannabis buds at airport, arrests mainland man
en.dek: A 31-year-old mainland passenger arriving from Bangkok via Singapore was arrested after officers found about 6 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds worth an estimated HK$1.1 million in his checked luggage.
body: Hong Kong Customs detected a drug trafficking case at Hong Kong International Airport on Sunday, seizing about 6 kilograms of suspected cannabis buds with an estimated market value of about HK$1.1 million and arresting a 31-year-old mainland man.

The passenger arrived from Bangkok, Thailand, via Singapore. During customs clearance, officers found the suspected drugs in his checked-in suitcase and arrested him. He has been charged with one count of trafficking in a dangerous drug and will appear at the West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts on Monday.

Customs said it will continue to step up enforcement against drug trafficking through intelligence analysis and risk-based selection of passengers from high-risk regions. Under the Dangerous Drugs Ordinance, trafficking in a dangerous drug carries a maximum penalty of a HK$5 million fine and life imprisonment.

zh.headline: 海關機場檢6公斤懷疑大麻花 拘31歲內地男子
zh.dek: 一名31歲內地男旅客由泰國曼谷經新加坡抵港，海關在其寄艙行李箱內發現約6公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約110萬元，男子已被控販運危險藥物罪，明日提堂。
body: 香港海關周日在香港國際機場偵破一宗行李藏毒的販毒案件，檢獲約6公斤懷疑大麻花，估計市值約110萬元，拘捕一名31歲內地男子。
該名男子當日從泰國曼谷經新加坡飛抵本港。海關人員替他進行清關時，在其攜同的寄艙行李箱內發現該批懷疑大麻花，遂將他拘捕。他被控以一項販運危險藥物罪，將於周一在西九龍裁判法院提堂。
海關表示會繼續根據情報分析加強打擊販運毒品活動，並按風險管理原則重點揀選來自高風險地區的旅客作清關檢查。根據《危險藥物條例》，販運危險藥物屬嚴重罪行，一經定罪，最高可被判罰款500萬元及終身監禁。
